persistent_caption: SIMULATED DATA | Research prototype | Not a medical device

shots.narration: OrbitVitals helps astronauts review changing health data.
shots.shot: Approved Demo 6 Today layout. Open on Crew B; keep the design and simulation notice visible.

shots.narration: Meet Noor: simulated records, checked for data quality.
shots.shot: Select the existing sleep card. Show the actual quality assessment; do not imply missing cadence was assessed.

shots.narration: Her personal median reference is eight hours.
shots.shot: Show the actual selected 480 min median reference from 14 synthetic in-flight observations. Caption: personal reference, not a target.

shots.narration: Two nights are insufficient. Five prompt review.
shots.shot: Show the actual two- and five-night stored results in the approved interface. Preserve the distinction between the latest nightly value and window median.

shots.narration: After nine, seven recorded nights show a continuing reduction. Two nights are missing.
shots.shot: Reveal the real nine-night chart and its gaps. Brief caption: median 430 min; slope -15 min/day. Keep the engine explanation visible or open its existing evidence disclosure.

shots.narration: Review the record with a flight surgeon. No diagnosis is made.
shots.shot: End on actual evidence and a human-review caption. Do not click an unavailable HTTP messaging action or show a sent confirmation. Credit NASA HRP sleep-risk context.
